consentModal.title: Manage Consent Preferences
consentModal.description: We use cookies. But not the delicious ones we sell in our bakery. These cookies are the digital type that enhances your experience and improves our website. Certain cookies are necessary and can’t be turned off, but we also allow others to place cookies to track the performance of our website and deliver personalized content and ads. You can select your preference using the buttons. If you're interested in learning more about how we handle your personal data, read our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

sections.title: Privacy Preference Center
sections.description:
We use cookies on our website to collect information about you, your preferences, or your device. You can click on the different cookie categories headings below to find out more and change the default setting according to your liking, except Strictly Necessary Cookies.

Some of the cookies described below are delivered by third parties, such as advertising networks, internet service providers, data analytics providers, operating systems and platforms, and social networks. Our relationships with these third parties and the types of cookies used may fall within the scope of a sale of personal data because the cookies may be used for marketing or delivering personalized ads. While you can opt-out of these third-party cookies by declining below, your selection only applies to cookie-related activity on our site. If you would like to submit a broader opt-out of sale request, in addition to making your preference selections below, you can click on this link to fill out and submit the appropriate form.

sections.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
sections.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms.    You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

sections.title: Performance Cookies
sections.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.    All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

sections.title: Functional Cookies
sections.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages.    If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

sections.title: Targeting & Advertising
sections.description: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.    They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
